request.description: A clear four-legged TROT IN PLACE facing right. Alternate diagonal paw pairs, lift and plant each weight-bearing paw, bend elbows and knees; shoulders and hips rise and fall naturally. Existing tails stream and sway with delayed follow-through, ears remain alert. Fixed screen position, smooth return to the supplied pose. Preserve the exact supplied ivory, gold and dark-plum fox, its face, eyes, fur markings, life stage, body proportions and EXACTLY 1 existing tail. Four paws and natural joints, grounded throughout. Sharp fine fur detail at native resolution. Entire silhouette inside canvas with generous padding, fixed right-facing camera and constant size. Transparent empty background, only the physical creature. Seamless loop.
